# Review addendum (append-only; does not replace verdict.md)

Added by the lead builder after a read-only adversarial review by a subordinate agent of the same session (`review/adversarial-review-D2.md`; no blocking issues, four should-fix items). verdict.md is left as written by the executing worker; where they differ, this wording governs. Not independent certification.

0. **Independence (stated first).** No written designation of an independent owner exists. Worker, reviewer and lead are one session lineage, which also produced the F3-A readjudication. Technical qualification result only. Freeze time is self-recorded; the harness file predates the protocol, so expectations were written after code existed.
1. **Q5 parity with the materialize row is a wrapper-parity check only** (both call one shared body, so parity holds by construction). Detection power comes from the absolute criteria (PermissionError, spy not called, no claim, no EffectTimeRefusal/attempt, destination unchanged). Every refusal row edits the persisted member only; live-side drift at claim issuance and non-member exits were not driven. The non-journal F4-only branch and a raising provision were not covered.
2. **Q4b is a classifier-level observation (equality over members), not "established" comparison sensitivity.** Under M06 the same derivation feeds the minted and the live member, so end-to-end comparison cannot differ on domain; "invisible to the comparison" applies to the binding-member comparison only (other guards were not run against M06). Q4 itself establishes persisted-content detection by the harness only.
3. **Baseline count.** The assignment's 73 matches the pre-AMEND-3/4 original harness (96 tests, 23 failed / 73 passed); the post-AMEND4 harness has 97 tests and passes 74. Not an interpreter difference.
